items.title: Tom Varner interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 13, 2025
items.q: I opened up a box and there was a program from I think it was May 1975... and it was when I played the movement from the Mozart horn concerto with my high school orchestra.

ctx.x: Meanwhile to get into the university of your choice did you have the classical horn repertoire under your belt as well?

A little. When I was in high school I was taking some classical French horn lessons with a local guy that was a couple of towns over and who was quite young himself so he was really encouraging and nice and wonderful. And so I did, I just looked at my – I was © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

opening boxes and trying to throw away – you know about this from moving – throwing away stuff – throwing away stuff, throwing away throwing away. And I opened up a box and there was a program from I think it was May 1975, so that’s 50 years plus a couple of months, and it was when I played the movement from the Mozart horn concerto with my high school orchestra.
